visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Seven young women in identical flight-attendant-style uniforms—red mini dresses with white trim, short white bolero jackets, and red neck scarves—stand in a V-formation in a long corridor. They perform a sequence of coordinated hand gestures, including finger-pointing and forming hearts, while maintaining bright, smiling facial expressions under neutral indoor lighting. (2) The group executes a synchronized dance routine characterized by rhythmic arm swings, clapping, and swaying hip movements. Their movements are precise and energetic, with the glossy floor reflecting the overhead lights and the industrial surroundings, including large metal shutters and white pipes on the ceiling, providing a stark contrast to their vibrant attire. (3) The camera performs a steady push-in towards the group as they continue dancing. One member in the foreground winks playfully and smiles widely, followed by another dancer who leans towards the lens, making a cute expression and pointing her finger at the viewer before the video ends abruptly.
